data.narrative:
Nara Space Technology is a public-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised KRW 33.5B (~$25M) to date. The peer universe consists of 4 same-sector, same-stage publicly traded comparables: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method is applicable and serves as the primary triangulation anchor. The median valuation across the four comparable public companies is $5.2B, with a range spanning $840M at the low end (Astroscale) to $40.0B at the high end (Rocket Lab). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied, as Nara's revenue is not on file; the broader Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 25.3x median P/S across six public tickers, but this requires known revenue to operationalize.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4.4B to $6.0B, centered on the peer median of $5.2B. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single applicable method across a limited set of four comparables. Key uncertainties include significant valuation dispersion within the peer set (80x range from minimum to maximum), the absence of revenue visibility for Nara, and the early-stage operational maturity of space-tech firms relative to traditional aerospace benchmarks. Additional diligence on customer contracts, launch cadence, and near-term revenue trajectory would be required to narrow the range.
